outcome: Blood loss >1000 ml at caesarean section
cohort: Women who underwent caesarean section in a UK maternity unit between 1995 and 2009
finding: The increased rate of excess blood loss at caesarean section during the latter period (2003-2009) could be the result of the reduced oxytocin dose.
mod_finding: The increased rate of excess blood loss at caesarean section during the latter period (2003-2009) could be the result of the reduced oxytocin dose.
